nina_prod: Quick thread to scope enterprise compliance pilot: customers want BYOK + long retention + predictable export SLAs. Who can list hard constraints we must meet for an MVP?
ravi_eng: Indexing for recent window is the big one. If we promise searchable results under 30s for 90 days, we need an index and a hot/warm split. Cold can be blobstore.
taylor_legal: Must include legal-hold semantics: hold prevents deletion and must be auditable (actor, time, reason). SOC2 reviewers will want proof we honored holds.
mohit_support: Pilot customers: one requires regional export locks, one requires 10y retention, another needs 24/7 evidence access. I'll collect exact contract text.
nina_prod: BYOK edge-case: what if customer deletes their key? We need clear options to present in onboarding.
ravi_eng: Options: escrow keys, re-encrypt to platform key at ingest (loses BYOK), or store ciphertext and mark as unrecoverable. Document tradeoffs.
ops-bot: deploy-note: compliance-retention branch deployed to staging at 1999010120. smoke-tests: index-build OK.
nina_prod: Proposed MVP acceptance: retention policy UI/API, legal-hold toggle, BYOK handshake docs + rotation policy, 90d index, basic export pipeline with 48h target for 1TB. Agree?taylor_legal: Add requirement: export manifest and key-handshake logs must be retained for audits.
mohit_support: I'll assemble pilot SLAs and customer constraints by EOD Friday.
ravi_eng: I'll drop an architecture sketch and cost estimate for hot/warm/cold by Friday.
nina_prod: Thanks all  we'll reconvene next week after the sketches.
